entries.2b1a70257f2ba764: This business conducts development, design, production and sales of toys and other products in Hong Kong, China, Thailand, Vietnam, South Korea and other locations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,975 million. Subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Shenzhen, Thailand and Vietnam are responsible for the Group's production, and they also make products for Japan and North America. Locally, sales of 'Tomica' and 'BEYBLADE X' and others also grew.
entries.2c2a5f620b7341fa: The company states that the strengths of its group are brands with global appeal and planning, development and product commercialization capabilities that can create hits in major countries. At TOMY COMPANY, LTD., the company works on BEYBLADE X, a modern version of beigoma; at Takara Tomy Arts, it works on gacha that grow through planning that uses IP; and at Kiddy Land, it works on creating experiential value through characters.
entries.2cfce248b0613717: This business plans, manufactures and sells infant products and toys, among others, and conducts IP licensing business, in the United States and Canada. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥30,405 million. TOMY International handles baby products and other items, Fat Brain Holdings handles original toys in the higher price range, and T-Licensing conducts IP licensing.

Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥210,434 million. In addition to the company itself, it includes TOMYTEC (model railways and other products), TAKARA TOMY ARTS (capsule toys and other products) and Kiddy Land (sales of toy and miscellaneous goods), among others; TAKARA TOMY MARKETING handles wholesale sales, and TAKARA TOMY IBIS also conducts real estate leasing, among other activities.
